title: AcademicPitfallChallengeContract
description: Contract schema for capturing methodological pitfalls, statistical traps, detected errors, and reusable resolutions.

pitfall_id.description: Unique identifier for the pitfall record (e.g. PIT-2026-CH4-001).

stage.description: Stage or milestone where pitfall occurred (e.g. 03_parametric_assumptions, 05_macro_model, Viva_Voce).

project.description: Project ID or study workspace identifier where the pitfall occurred.

candidate_approach.description: Initial or proposed approach that contained the defect (e.g. Standard ANCOVA with unequal variances).

problem.description: Exact methodological, statistical, or typography defect identified.

detected_by.description: Agent or validator that identified the defect (e.g. statistical-auditor, academic-challenger, evidence-auditor).

reusable.description: Flag indicating whether this pitfall pattern should be indexed in case-based memory for future projects.

timestamp.description: ISO 8601 timestamp when pitfall was detected or recorded.

related_artifacts.description: Artifact paths or IDs directly implicated by or produced during this pitfall.
